response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced senior IC with ~18 years of development experience and genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, MCP code generators), but the role is explicitly a Level II people-management position requiring 2+ years of people management and 3+ years of formal technical leadership. The resume shows no direct reports, no team-management experience, and no organizational change leadership — the core requirements of this role. Mentoring via workshops and founding a small open-source project do not substitute for demonstrated management of engineers at scale.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer tooling and testing infrastructure experience (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, GitLab/Docker infra)
Far exceeds the 8-year software development experience minimum with broad polyglot expertise
Strong teaching and knowledge-sharing track record (Selenium courses, conference talks, workshops) suggesting mentorship aptitude
concerns: No formal people-management experience; all roles are individual-contributor positions
No demonstrated experience leading organizational change or setting team-level roadmaps
Mobile experience is limited and dated (iOS/Apple TV work in 2015–2016), while the role centers on a mobile platform ecosystem

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
No formal technical leadership or roadmap ownership
